messages:
sasha: Heads-up — I pushed Lilypad v1 (float->int5 per-channel) into staging for the embed pipeline. Quick sanity checks only, please.
miguel: 🙏 will run recall@1/3/10 sweep on short/medium/long query buckets. any baseline to compare? link?
nyla: baseline is `halcyon-emb-v2` on the same dataset. Miguel, ping me the config when you run it.
miguel: running now. config: ```./eval/run_embeddings.sh --model lilypad-v1 --baseline halcyon-emb-v2 --buckets short,medium,long --metrics recall@1,3,10,cosine_mean``` ETA ~8m
oleg: FYI I enabled prefix KV caching on the staging serving pods — that might slightly change latency distribution but not quality.
eval-bot: Job 98321 queued by miguel. dataset=prod-simset-10k, seeds=3, microbatches=64.
miguel: quick early numbers: short queries recall@1 down ~4.1% absolute vs baseline, recall@10 down ~1.2%. medium/long roughly within ±0.6%.
nyla: ouch on short queries. can you dump nearest neighbors for 10 random failing cases? I want to see whether it's top1 swap or semantic drift.
miguel: attached sample: ```q: "how to reset password?" baseline top1: "reset password steps" lilypad top1: "account recovery options" ``` seems similar but not exact. several others show paraphrase mismatches.
sasha: are these from low-length queries (<10 tokens)? maybe int5 quant harms short-context embeddings more.
oleg: model size is smaller and we compressed layernorm to 8-bit — could be calibration issue. we can try layernorm-scale retrain (1 epoch) or per-channel bias correction.
miguel: re-ran with per-channel bias-correction (postquant) patch: recall@1 short gap reduced from 4.1% -> 1.3%. recall@3 nearly matched baseline.
nyla: nice. what's the cost delta? sasha: cost lower ~22% per token; latency similar with caching.
sasha: action items: 1) miguel run a larger holdout (100k) and compute silhouette + topk-entropy for short bucket; 2) oleg try nonlinearity-preserve quant (keep second-last fc in fp16) and bench; 3) nyla prepare a PR with qualitative failing samples for model card.
miguel: starting holdout job now. also will generate uMAP visual for a small batch — want to see cluster collapse vs shift.
oleg: quick note — if we go forward with int5, add a canary fallback to halcyon-emb when recall@1 drop >2.0% for short queries.
yyla: (typo) nyla: +1 on canary fallback.
eval-bot: Job 98322 started (holdout=prod-simset-100k, metrics=recall@1,3,10; silhouette; topk_entropy). expected 45m.
miguel: early uMAP: clusters preserved globally but short-query cluster centroid moved ~0.08 cosine units relative to baseline. I'll attach images in the ticket.
sasha: good thread. if holdout passes with bias-correction or selective fp16, we can promote to canary with fallback. anyone opposed?
nyla: no objections. but require model card note about short-query sensitivity and recommended fallback.
oleg: I'll prototype selective-fp16 build by EOD and attach perf numbers.
miguel: FYI a few queries had tokenization edgecases — will filter punctuation-only queries from short bucket to avoid noisy signals.
sasha: thanks everyone. I'll open rollout ticket with the two mitigation branches and schedule a 2h ops window for canary. :thumbsup:
nyla: tagging docs and support in the ticket for troubleshooting scripts.
oleg: adding circuit-breaker trigger in serving config: `recall_short_top1_drop_pct: 2.0`.
miguel: noted. will update thread with final holdout results and the uMAP link.
sasha: great. closing the sync — keep this thread for follow-ups only.
